name: Fleischmannia

project_scope.range_status: UNRESOLVED pending BONAP target county documentation

look_here_first: Look at one mature opposite triangular TOOTHED leaf, then the SIDE OF ONE flower head. Fleischmannia incarnata is a loose weak/sprawling herb with small pink-lilac heads; the ~4–5 mm involucre with relatively few ranks of phyllaries is the strongest visible separator from much more cylindrical bract-layered fragrant mistflower (Chromolaena odorata, ~8–10 mm).
shared_genus_traits: Opposite long-stalked toothed leaves and much-branched herbaceous flowering growth.
Discoid Asteraceae heads without ray flowers in terminal flat-topped/open arrays.
Individual florets pink-purple or whitish; color not definitive.
Flat or somewhat convex head receptacle; sharply demarcated stopper-shaped carpopodium is expert microscopic trait.

quick_key.if: Longer ~8–10 mm cylindrical individual heads with MANY rows of bracts below flower tops
quick_key.then: Chromolaena odorata (fragrant mistflower), not this genus

quick_key.if: Fewer florets/head (often 13–25), ~4–5 mm short involucre, lax herbaceous stems, opposite toothed triangular leaves
Dense heads with MANY florets (~35–70+) and a noticeably CONIC receptacle on dissection
Deeply cut or dissected leaf blades
Persistent woody or shrub-like framework with whitish blooms
quick_key.then: Consider Ageratina havanensis (white mistflower); verify bracts

species_comparison_matrix.caution: count ONE capitulum, not entire cluster

species_comparison_matrix.chromolaena_odorata: opposite broadly ovate/triangular, toothed, 3 prominent basal veins

comparison_cards.title: Pink thoroughwort or fragrant mistflower?
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Single flower HEAD FROM SIDE: 4–5 mm shorter/inconspicuous phyllary tiers versus 8–10 mm long cylinder with many visible overlapping bract ranks.
photo_requirements: sharp bract-layer macro on both taxa
paired opposite leaves in field context
comparison_cards.caution: Pink petals and opposite leaves overlap; no final ID by color alone.

comparison_cards.title: Pink thoroughwort or blue mistflower?
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Count disk florets per SINGLE head and look at stripped receptacle: Fleischmannia fewer florets and flat/convex base, Conoclinium numerous florets and conic base.
comparison_cards.caution: Purple-pink/blue color ranges overlap; habit and leaves are supporting.
